title: Protecting Safety during Reasoning Training with Low-Rank Fisher Regularisation
abstract: arXiv:2611.20288v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models are trained to have safety guardrails, but these can be compromised while fine-tuning for new capabilities, such as reasoning. One way to mitigate this degradation is to modify the fine-tuning objective to preserve safety behaviour, but doing so effectively and efficiently remains challenging. We revisit Elastic Weight Consolidation (EWC), which penalises parameter updates based on sensitivity estimates from the diagonal of the Fisher information matrix (FIM). While EWC provides some protection, the diagonal approximation ignores interactions between parameters. We address this limitation by exploiting recent findings that safety-relevant behaviour is located in a low-rank subspace within models. Our method, Subspace-Projected Elastic Weight Consolidation (SP-EWC), projects gradients onto this subspace to capture non-diagonal curvature efficiently. translated_title: 基于低秩Fisher正则化在推理训练中保护安全性
translated_abstract: 大语言模型经过训练具备安全防护机制，但在为推理等新能力进行微调时，这些机制可能被破坏。缓解这种安全性能退化的一种方法是修改微调目标以保留安全行为，但如何有效且高效地做到这一点仍然具有挑战性。我们重新审视了弹性权重整合（EWC）方法，该方法基于Fisher信息矩阵（FIM）对角线的敏感度估计来惩罚参数更新。虽然EWC提供了一定的保护，但对角近似忽略了参数之间的相互作用。我们通过利用近期关于安全相关行为位于模型内部低秩子空间的研究发现来解决这一局限。我们的方法——子空间投影弹性权重整合（SP-EWC）——将梯度投影到该子空间上，从而高效地捕获非对角曲率。我们研究了识别安全子空间的三种不同方法。
tldr: 提出SP-EWC方法，通过将梯度投影到低秩安全子空间以捕获非对角曲率，从而在推理能力微调过程中高效保护大语言模型的安全行为。
en_tdlr: Proposes SP-EWC, which projects gradients onto a low-rank safety subspace to efficiently capture non-diagonal curvature, preserving LLM safety behavior during reasoning fine-tuning.
